dct_description_sm: Environics Environmental Monitor (EEM) is a public opinion survey of Canadian citizens. The Environmental Monitor is a syndicated quarterly report of Canadian public attitudes toward environmental and natural resource issues. Each quarterly report is based on the results of 1,500 telephone interviews with a representative sample of adult Canadians. Currently, data are available through the Canadian Opinion Research Archive from 1987. EEM is produced by Environics Research Group Limited, Toronto, Ontario. Environics Environmental Monitor, 1991-3 is a telephone survey of 1,508 adult Canadians conducted during the period from August 27 to September 10, 1991.
